about.ourHistoryTagline: A House of Prayer for All Nations
about.ourHistoryDescription: Founded in 2005, First Haitian Baptist Church of Kissimmee was born from the vision of several Haitian families who desired to create a spiritual home where Christian faith and cultural heritage intertwine harmoniously. Over the years, our church has grown to become a vibrant and welcoming community, committed to serving the Haitian population in the Orlando area while being a light to all nations. Guided by God's Word and animated by the Holy Spirit, we continue to move forward with faith, hope, and love, seeking to transform lives through the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

pastor.name: Pastor Fritzner JB Brouard
pastor.bio: Pastor Brouard brings over 25 years of experience in pastoral ministry. A graduate of the Evangelical Theological Seminary of Haiti, he is passionate about biblical teaching and the spiritual development of the community.
pastor.fullBio: Fritzner JB Brouard was born in Haiti on March 25, 1957 to father Fritz JB Brouard and mother Noëlzina M Dumas. After his secondary studies, he studied civil engineering and human sciences. Some time later, he moved to the United States where he married his first love Orlande Bastien and God blessed them with three beautiful children (Jeff-Carl, Rebecca and Naomi). He pursued his career in management to take care of his family. To better serve his Redeemer Jesus Christ, he studied theology at several levels and in the nineties, he became one of the famous preachers of the Gospel. He has written several articles, brochures, magazines etc. He has published twenty-one works. Now, he is the Pastor of the First Haitian Baptist Church of Kissimmee (Florida, for nine years) and he is counted among the best teachers, conference speakers, orators, poets, writers in the Haitian evangelical world.

bridge.title: Bridge Ministry
bridge.description:
The Bridge Ministry is dedicated to celebrating and supporting the educational achievements of our church family. Each year, we organize the Annual Student Recognition Program to honor students of all ages—from preschool and elementary school to middle school, high school, college, university, vocational, and graduate programs—as they complete another academic year or reach significant milestones.

In addition to recognizing academic accomplishments, the ministry plans and coordinates church-wide fellowship and entertainment activities that bring families together in a joyful, Christ-centered environment. Through meaningful events, celebrations, and community engagement, we encourage students to pursue excellence, inspire lifelong learning, strengthen relationships within the church, and give all glory to God for every achievement.

Our mission is to encourage every student to grow academically, spiritually, and personally while reminding them that their gifts, talents, and success are blessings from God. We strive to create memorable experiences that inspire future generations to serve Christ faithfully and positively impact their communities.

“Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.” — Proverbs 22:6
